cards.name: Antique Holder
cards.text: When this enters play, you may Stash an additional card from your hand.

cards.name: Moron's Gold
cards.text: Ready 1 Stash. If you have 2 or more Deals, Ready another Stash.

cards.name: Family Heirloom
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. The attached Character gets +1 Guard at 0–1 Deals, +2 Guard at 2–3 Deals, or +3 Guard at 4 Deals. If attached to Antique Holder, that Character also has Retaliate.

cards.name: Grandma With a Million-Dollar Doorstop
cards.text: Sentimental Value: When this enters play, gain 1 Deal. You can't spend your last Deal while this is in play.
cards.flavor: “PLEASE. Just name your price.” — Shady Pawn Shop Owner

cards.name: Guy Selling His Wife's Dress
cards.text: Twenty Bucks Is Twenty Bucks: This gets +1 Trouble while you have 2 or more Deals.

cards.name: Guy Who Got a Bad Deal
Junkyard Visionary
cards.text: When this enters play, you may Draw 1 card, then Discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: “Dude, did you find that at a dump?” — Shady Pawn Shop Owner

cards.name: One Man's Trash
cards.text: Choose a card in your discard. Put it into your hand.

cards.name: Black Friday Employee
cards.text: Everything Must Go: During your Ready step, if this is Rotated, you may leave it Rotated. While it remains Rotated this way, your other Customers cost 1 less.
cards.flavor: “Ma'am, buy one, get one free does not mean you can take the free one.”

cards.name: No Refunds
cards.text: Spend 1 Deal: Dismiss an opposing Character costing 4 or less.
